indexes: CREATE INDEX run_failure_closes_pending ON stateknot.run_failure_closes USING btree (tenant_id, journal_recorded_at, run_id) WHERE (completed_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_failure_closes_pkey ON stateknot.run_failure_closes USING btree (tenant_id, run_id)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER child_ownership_failure_close_guard BEFORE INSERT ON stateknot.child_run_ownership FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stateknot.guard_failure_close_spawn()
CREATE TRIGGER failure_closes_capture_children AFTER INSERT ON stateknot.run_failure_closes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stateknot.capture_failure_close_children()

CREATE TRIGGER runs_failure_close_complete AFTER UPDATE ON stateknot.runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stateknot.complete_run_failure_close()
CREATE TRIGGER runs_failure_close_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON stateknot.runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stateknot.guard_run_failure_close()
